brand.name: Corsair
brand.about: American maker of PC components and gaming peripherals, founded in 1994 as Corsair Microsystems; its keyboards span the K-series, VANGUARD, MAKR and GALLEON lines.

keyboards.notes: Wired 60% Hall-effect board; an ARC Raiders edition exists.

75% board with a magnetic decorative top case (Drop CSTM80). Box includes a USB cable, switch puller and extra gaskets; hot-swap is inferred from the switch puller, pin count and stock switches not stated on the page read.

reviews.verdict: A gaming keyboard with a built-in Stream Deck; good, though buying both separately is an option.
Thocky typing combined with an integrated Stream Deck.
